paper.title: RoFormer vs BERT-style absolute positions, MLM pretraining (Section 4.5.1 analogue)

note: The paper pretrains RoFormer (BERT-base sized) on BookCorpus + Wikipedia for the English MLM comparison, fine-tunes on GLUE, evaluates Performer+RoPE on Enwik8, and pretrains a Chinese RoFormer on ~34GB of Chinese text for CAIL2019-SCM. The train loop here uses synthetic periodic sequences; real corpora require a tokenized data loader. LR/warmup values are assumptions; consult Section 4 for exact settings.
